verifyToken.hint: Any random string. Leave blank to use the generated one shown above.

requireSignature.label: Require a signature on every webhook
requireSignature.hint: Rejects Interakt-forwarded events that carry no valid Meta signature. Turn on only if Interakt signs them.

enabled.hint: Turns on the separate manifest, install prompt and notifications on /team-inbox.

icon192.label: App icon (192x192 PNG)

icon512.label: Large icon / splash (512x512 PNG)

todo.title: Push notifications: one step left

seoPreview.sitemapFile: Auto-generated from public pages and published blog posts. Submit /sitemap.xml to Google Search Console.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Core application identity, contact information, default locale and currency, and platform-level service switches.

appName.title: App name
appName.body: Used in page titles, emails and the in-app brand. Keep short: ideally one or two words.

appUrl.title: App URL
appUrl.body: The canonical address. All callbacks, emails and OAuth redirects derive from this.

language.title: Default language
language.body: Applied to new accounts. Existing users keep whatever they picked.

currency.title: Default currency
currency.body: Used for invoices and wallets without an explicit override.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.body: When ON every non-admin route shows a placeholder. Admin can still reach the console.

tip.title: Production rule
tip.body: Save only after testing the affected user flow. Identity changes propagate to invoices and outbound emails.

appearance.title: Dashboard colours
appearance.description: Recolour the entire app, every page of the user dashboard and the admin panel, by changing these theme colours. Saving applies instantly to everyone; leave a colour at its default to keep the shipped look.

layout.title: Navigation layout
layout.description: Choose how the user dashboard is laid out. Sidebar moves every menu into a left rail (no top header, no More page).

sidebar.title: Sidebar colour
sidebar.description: The dark left rail background (sidebar layout only). Leave the default for the shipped near-black.

how.title: Applies instantly
how.body: Saving rewrites the live theme tokens for everyone.

tokens.title: One token, one job
tokens.body: Each swatch maps to a single CSS variable used across the user dashboard and the admin panel.

primary.title: Change Primary, the rest follows
primary.body: Primary (hover), accent, soft fill and chat bubble are derived from Primary unless you set them yourself.

defaults.title: Leave defaults alone
defaults.body: Any colour left at its shipped value keeps the original look; only changed tokens are overridden.

tip.title: Tip
tip.body: Check contrast after big changes. Text and background colours both come from these tokens.

siteInfo.title: Site info
siteInfo.description: Contact details and social links shared across the footer, contact and about pages. Edit once, they update everywhere.

shared.title: Shared everywhere
shared.body: These values feed the public footer, the contact page and the legal pages.

frontend.title: Page text and colours
frontend.body: Edited in the Frontend editor, not here.

footer.title: Footer settings
footer.description: Footer title, social links, copyright text and the public footer description.

what.title: Footer title and copyright
what.body: Empty title uses the platform name. Empty copyright text is generated from the year and the brand.

social.title: Social URLs
social.body: Empty fields hide the icon. These share the Site info social links: editing here updates them everywhere.

mail.title: Mail settings
mail.description: SMTP host, port, encryption and credentials. Saved values are applied on every send, so welcome, verification, receipt and support mail use them without a restart.

hosts.title: Typical settings
hosts.body: Mailgun smtp.mailgun.org 587 / tls. SendGrid smtp.sendgrid.net 587 / tls. Amazon SES email-smtp.<region>.amazonaws.com 587 / tls. Postmark smtp.postmarkapp.com 587 / tls. Resend smtp.resend.com 587 / tls. Gmail smtp.gmail.com 587 / tls with an app password.

used.title: Mailables in the system
used.body: Welcome and verification emails, password reset, invoices and receipts, support replies, security alerts and workspace invites.

tip.title: Tip
tip.body: Always send a test after editing. A single typo in the host or port silently breaks every transactional email in the platform.

seo.title: SEO settings
seo.description: Site-wide default meta tags: title, description, OpenGraph, Twitter cards, robots, canonical and search-engine verification.

basics.title: Titles and descriptions
basics.body: Meta title: lead with the brand and one strong descriptor, 50-60 characters. Meta description: a 1-2 sentence pitch, 140-160 characters.

where.title: Where this shows
where.body: Admin pages, signed-in pages, public pages and link previews (WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, X). Robots: use noindex for staging or private deployments.

sitemap.title: Validate
sitemap.body: opengraph.xyz, Google Rich Results test and the Twitter Card validator.

privacy.title: Privacy, GDPR & ADA
privacy.description: Cookie consent banner, policy URLs, GDPR / CCPA compliance and WCAG accessibility toggles. The same setting feeds the consent UI and gates every analytics integration.

order.title: Order of operations
order.body: 1. The visitor lands and the cookie banner opens (skipped when Do-Not-Track is respected). 2. The choice is saved in the crm_cookie_consent cookie for one year. 3. Only the allowed trackers are loaded. 4. The visitor can reopen the picker from any element with data-cookie-prefs-open.

linked.title: Linked settings
linked.body: Analytics integrations (GA4, GTM, Pixel, Clarity and more) and PWA settings.

analytics.title: Analytics integrations
analytics.description: Paste each provider ID once. The official vendor snippet is rendered on every public page, but only after the visitor consents to the matching cookie category.

categories.title: When each fires
categories.body: Analytics: GA4, GTM, Clarity, Plausible, PostHog, Hotjar, Mixpanel. Marketing: Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn, X Pixel. GTM container scripts may include further trackers; pause them with category triggers inside GTM.

where.title: Where loaded
where.body: Public and sign-in pages. Admin pages are intentionally off.

custom.title: Custom code
custom.description: Production custom styles and scripts for advanced branding and behaviour. Injected into public pages when enabled.

scope.title: Scope your CSS
scope.body: Wrap rules with a brand class. Avoid touching body, *, or framework utility classes.

block.title: Do not block
block.body: Wrap JS in DOMContentLoaded. No synchronous network calls.

dark.title: Test dark mode
dark.body: Toggle the theme and check html[data-theme="dark"] selectors before saving.

sensitive.title: Production-sensitive
sensitive.body: A bad save reaches every public page instantly. Have a teammate review big diffs.

tip.title: Careful
tip.body: Custom code runs on every public page and cannot be sandboxed. Only a super admin can change it.

pwa.title: PWA settings
pwa.description: Installable app manifest: name, icons, colours and display mode. Drives the manifest and the install prompt.

manifest.title: Live manifest
manifest.body: The manifest is served at /api/v2/public/manifest.webmanifest and exists only while the switch is on.

install.title: Icons
install.body: Upload square PNG icons on the Appearance page or paste hosted URLs. 192 px for the home screen, 512 px for the splash.

storage.title: Cloud storage
storage.description: Send client media to your own bucket: Amazon S3, Wasabi, Bunny.net, DigitalOcean Spaces, Cloudflare R2 or any S3-compatible store. When off, media stays on the local disk, so nothing breaks until you turn it on.

s3.title: S3 / Wasabi
s3.body: Access key + secret + region + bucket. The Wasabi endpoint is derived from the region.

bunny.title: Bunny.net
bunny.body: Use the Bunny fields: storage zone and password. Region is the zone region (de, ny, la...).

spaces.title: Spaces / R2 / MinIO
spaces.body: Fill the S3 fields and paste the Endpoint URL. Tick path-style for MinIO.

test.title: Always test first
test.body: "Save & test connection" writes and deletes a probe file before you flip Enabled on.

tip.title: Safe by default
tip.body: Existing files stay where they are. Only new uploads go to the bucket; nothing is migrated or deleted.

realtime.title: Real-time notifications
realtime.description: One Pusher app powers the live Team Inbox for every workspace: new messages, status changes and snooze wake-ups appear instantly. Platform-wide; users never enter keys.

how.title: One app, all workspaces
how.body: The server broadcasts with the secret; pages load only the public key.

live.title: What goes live
live.body: Inbound messages and operator replies push a light signal and the inbox refreshes instantly.

poll.title: Polling stays as fallback
poll.body: If Pusher is off or unreachable the inbox keeps its slower poll so nothing is missed.

test.title: Test it
test.body: Use "Save & test connection" to fire a live event at Pusher and confirm the credentials.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp settings
whatsapp.description: The one Meta app (and Interakt partner) every workspace's WhatsApp numbers are onboarded through. Without an app id and secret, Embedded Signup and token renewal do not work; without a config id, workspaces paste a token manually. Saved values override the server defaults within seconds, in every process.

metaApp.title: Business API (WABA)
metaApp.description: Meta's official Cloud API. Required for high-volume traffic, template messages and a verified business profile. Supports both manual token paste and Embedded Signup (WhatsApp login).

interakt.title: Interakt route
interakt.description: Numbers connected through Embedded Signup are sent and received through Interakt's Meta proxy by default. Switch to Meta (direct) to skip Interakt. Existing numbers keep the route they were connected with.

api.title: Meta Cloud API
api.body: Meta's official Cloud API. Required for high-volume traffic, template messages, and a verified business profile. Supports both manual token paste and Embedded Signup (WhatsApp login).

app.title: Facebook app ID + secret
app.body: developers.facebook.com/apps, Basic settings. Changing the app invalidates tokens issued by the old one, so workspaces must reconnect.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.body: App dashboard, WhatsApp, Configuration: paste the Callback URL and Verify token from this page, then subscribe to messages and message_template_status_update.

perWorkspace.title: Per-workspace
perWorkspace.body: Each workspace connects its own number from Channels, WhatsApp numbers. Phone number ID and a permanent token are collected there.

login.title: WABA login (optional)
login.body: Fill the Embedded Signup Config ID to enable one-click Sign in with Meta. Requires the Tech Provider role on the app. Leave blank to use manual paste only.

tip.title: Tip
tip.body: Switching the default route or the app mid-traffic affects only numbers connected afterwards. Pause campaigns before changing the Meta app.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.body: Needed for the site to work: sign-in, security and your choices. Always on.

analytics.title: Analytics cookies
analytics.body: Help us understand how the site is used so we can improve it.

marketing.title: Marketing cookies
marketing.body: Used to measure ads and show you relevant campaigns elsewhere.

appearance.previewNote: Colours, size and opacity update as you drag. Nothing is applied to anyone until you save.
appearance.resetBody: Clears all overrides and restores the original palette.

wabaCallback.unavailable: Webhook details are shown to super admins only.
wabaCallback.webhookHint: Paste into the Meta app (WhatsApp, Configuration, Callback URL). Subscribe to: {fields}.
wabaCallback.verifyHint: Paste into the same screen as the Verify token.
